_source: Verbatim Thai keys from pototype/ap.jsx APPaymentVoucher (L167-234) + PVCreateForm (L236-315). Kept in .json (the i18n-guard hook skips .json) so Thai/baht never appear in .tsx source — same pattern as gl/jv-strings.json. crumbSection/crumbScreen render the breadcrumb. Each value is the prototype phrase VERBATIM (glyph-checked: middot U+00B7, em-dash U+2014, baht U+0E3F) EXCEPT netWhtLabel / netRetentionLabel which drop the mock rate suffix ('3% (ค่าบริการ)' / '10% (WO)') because the rate is derived per-billing, not a static label. methodListTransfer is the LIST badge label ('โอน', ap.jsx PV_LIST) vs methodTransfer the FORM button label ('โอนเงิน', PVCreateForm). Values present in i18n-full.json.phrases resolve via tp(); values in _missing are NOT yet in i18n-full.json — they render honest Thai (th) / key-fallback and are flagged for the Wave-2 i18n round (P2-WEB-14). Status/cancel reuse existing DICT keys (common.status / common.cancel) via t(), not this file.
